direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has finished her father's call and exchanged farewells with Kasun. The warmth of their meeting lingers beneath her subdued mood as they part.
direction.people: Anudi stands frame left facing Kasun, wearing a plain cream blouse and muted teal skirt, with her phone in her right hand, open umbrella in her left and handbag on her left forearm. Her faint smile retains some warmth. Kasun stands frame right facing her in a faded blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, his empty hands at his sides; he seems reluctant to turn back to his food three-wheeler in the right background.

flow.text: For the opening moment, Anudi holds her faint smile and Kasun keeps his eyes on her. Both remain still without making the pause formal.

Anudi turns and walks away into the left roadside depth, keeping the phone in her right hand, umbrella in her left and handbag on her left forearm. Kasun stays behind, following her departure with his eyes.
After a short hesitation, Kasun turns and walks into the right depth toward the food three-wheeler, lowering his gaze toward it. His return has less purpose than his attention to her departure.
Anudi continues away at left depth while Kasun settles near the vehicle at right depth, his gaze still low. Both face away, leaving the space between their paths visible.

direction.camera: An eye-level wide shot from the road side on a 35mm lens holds both full figures and their diverging paths in a steady frame on a tripod.
direction.sound: Light rain, distant traffic and soft footsteps; no music.
